messages:
mira: Heads-up — onboarding callisto-7b-v1 into the eval harness. Chat-template tests are failing on emoji-heavy prompts, we're seeing a ~4% drop on EM/BLEU for a few benchmarks. Suspect tokenizer is splitting surrogate-pair / ZWJ emoji sequences incorrectly.

sam: Can you paste a failing example + what the tokenizer output looks like?

mira: Here’s a minimal repro from the runner logs:
```
Prompt: "User: Describe the experiment carried out by the emoji 👩‍🔬🧪 and summarize results."
Tokenized: ["User", ":", "Describe", "the", "experiment", "carried", "out", "by", "the", "emoji", "\uD83D", "\uDC69", "\u200D", "\uD83E", "\uDDEA", "and", "summarize", "results", "."]
Collate error: AssertionError: prefix length mismatch (expected 5, got 3)
```
So we’re literally getting half-surrogates and ZWJ components as separate tokens, and downstream collate/asserts blow up or the model ends up with misaligned prefixes.

eval-bot: CI: job eval-harness/chat-template-callisto #2078 failed — https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/jobs/2078 (logs attached)

devin: That matches a long-standing pretokenizer hack: some legacy path encoded to utf-16-le then sliced bytes for speed, which utterly breaks surrogate pairs and ZWJ sequences. Two options: revert to utf-8-normalized pipeline or switch to a grapheme-cluster aware pre-split (use regex "\X" via the regex module). I recommend grapheme-preserve; it's more future-proof for emojis and complex scripts.

ryan: Additional note: normalization form matters. We've been applying NFKC in model configs for older models which can decompose some sequences. For chat-style templates we probably want NFC and grapheme preservation. We also expose "tokenizer.normalize_unicode" in model YAML — maybe set to "NFC" for callisto.

nina: I’ll add focused unit tests in the eval-harness: tests/test_tokenization_unicode.py with cases for:
- ZWJ emoji (👩‍🔬🧪)
- skin-tone modifiers (👍🏽)
- flag sequences (🇺🇸)
- surrogate pairs from historic planes
And gate them in CI so future regressions fail early.

sam: I can take the code change. Plan:
1) Add grapheme cluster pre-splitter behind a config flag `grapheme_cluster_preserve` (default true for chat templates).
2) Switch model-config for callisto-7b-v1 to `tokenizer: callisto-v1-utf8` + `normalize_unicode: NFC`.
3) Add the tests nina described and update the onboarding checklist.
PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/1987 (WIP)

mira: Nice. Also add a smoke step to onboarding: `scripts/smoke_tokenize_unicode.sh` that runs a handful of emoji/grapheme cases and fails fast. Put it in the model-config checklist so product onboarding doesn't miss it.

devin: After PR merge, re-run CI job #2078; if we still see metric drift, we should add a temporary runner-level fallback that maps lone surrogates -> <UNK_SENTINEL> so collate & eval metrics remain stable while we validate quality.

sam: Will do. Expect PR today, tests included. Ping me on this thread for reviews or if you see other weird unicode cases. :thumbsup:
